messages:
carolyn: Heads up — got a high-priority ticket from Marketplace (Azure) — models using quantized kernels failing on CUDA 12.3 images. Error appears in production on dedicated pools.
ajay: Logs? Which models and images exactly?
carolyn: Pasted error from one of the nodes: ```E kernel_quantize: kernel_out_of_bounds at kv_cache_step 2048
Traceback (most recent call last): ...``` Happening on rtx-a100 family, only on images with driver 535.102.03 + CUDA 12.3.
ajay: Sounds like a regression in the 535 driver series combined with cu12.3. Short-term options: pin driver to 535.98 or roll to 536.x if NV provides a hotfix. For Marketplace images, pinning is lower friction. Recommend canary with driver 535.98 + smoke tests.
maria: tagging @jordan to coordinate with Azure / SI partners. Jordan, can you confirm if marketplace image pinning is possible without full re-approval?
jordan: Azure engineering said we can publish a minor image update under the existing image listing but it needs partner sign-off and a short review (security scan). I opened a fast-track request. ETA for approval ~24-48h if we provide clear regression evidence and a patch.
vendor-nv-bot: NV Hotfix ETA: 2024-12-05 02:00 UTC for driver 535.110.01 (addresses quant kernel regression). Recommend planning a fallback policy until hotfix lands.
leo: Proposal: 1) Create a canary pool pinned to driver 535.98, 2) Add runtime fallback to a quant-compat model variant (FP16 decode fallback) for affected routes, 3) Add strict rollout steps and monitoring in release lane. I can spin up the canary config.
ajay: Canary config snippet (for infra PR): ```image: redwood/rlruntime:cuda12.3-driver-535.98
env:
  RW_CANARY: "true"
routes:
  - /v1/chat: model=redwood-quant-<variant>
health_checks:
  - script: grep -q "kernel_quantize" /var/log/runtime.log || exit 0
``` Also will add smoke tests that exercise quant kernels and verify no out_of_bounds.
carolyn: I'll draft partner comms — include repro steps, error logs, and metric diffs (latency + error spike graphs). Who owns publishing the patch notes to Marketplace?
maria: I'll own the comms draft and loop in PS/legal. Action items: jordan open Marketplace ticket (in progress), ajay + leo create canary + fallback, carolyn prepare repro + metrics, maria draft partner email. Target: canary up within 6 hours, initial partner update in 2 hours.
ajay: Started PR for canary + smoke tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4921 :thumbsup:
jordan: Marketplace ticket created: https://portal.azure.com/ticket/12345 — added SI contacts @acme-si and @sunrise-intl, severity=High. Will post approval ETA there.
vendor-nv-bot: Note from NV: if you cannot wait for the official hotfix, rollback to driver 535.98 or 534.x series; 536.x is currently untested with these quant kernels.
carolyn: Thanks everyone — we'll post running status to #partnerships and #marketplace-incidents. Flagging this for oncall and for the next standup.
